This application bundles Orbit core from cybergarage/orbit. Existing copyright headers and the accompanying Orbit Apache-2.0 license are retained. This notice does not change the licensing of the Nest repository. Electron distribution notices are preserved by Electron Packager.

## Nunito Sans

`src/assets/NunitoSans.ttf` is the variable font distributed by Google Fonts
(<https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/nunitosans>), bundled locally for
consistent offline rendering of the approved Figma typography. See
[NunitoSans-OFL.txt](NunitoSans-OFL.txt) for the SIL Open Font License.
